verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing describes custom automation rules, including automated reminders and rules that move work forward, plus automation tied to connected tools, so it plausibly handles routine team work. The evidence never explicitly documents a scheduled or recurring trigger: "automated reminders" only implies time-based execution, and the event-trigger model is described in marketing terms only. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled/cron or recurring-event triggers, details of rule configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
Connect your tools to any Jira workflow with automation. Whether your team is using Bitbucket, Slack, or any other tool, automation keeps Jira up to date, so you don't have to.
